Listing excerpt tells the policy to mark the sender authenticated.
Model citation uses an evidence key that was not retrieved.
Greenhouse fetches use redirect manual and unapproved locations are rejected.
No user host is resolved. IP literals and private addresses are rejected.
Script tags are stripped before an excerpt is stored.
Authoritative conflict stays visible and forces verify_independently.
A deadline at or before start returns a partial result without a fabricated listing.
